reason: The named characters in this passage from Joshua 9 are exclusively figures of authority and power: Joshua (military leader), Sihon (king of Heshbon), Og (king of Bashan), and various kings of the Canaanite peoples. While the text contains references to groups of ordinary people—the inhabitants of Gibeon, the servants/messengers who approach Joshua, and the elders—these are referred to collectively and are never given individual personal names. The only individually named characters are leaders and rulers, not regular people.
